mapper.sql: A.receiving_id, A.supplier_id, A.order_id, A.order_node_id, A.receiving_status, A.create_time, A.create_by, A.update_time, A.update_by
mapper.select: SELECT so.order_id orderId, c.supplier_name supplierName, -- 客户名称 omp.update_time updateTime, -- 送货日期 ifnull(m.materiel_name,omp.materiel_id) materielName, -- 产品名称 ifnull(omp.order_num,0) detailsNum, -- 销售数量 ifnull(omp.materiel_num,0) fulfillNum, -- 已送货数量 ifnull(omp.order_num,0)-ifnull(omp.materiel_num,0) surplusNum, -- 剩余数量 omp.plan_id planId, 0 thisNum FROM brt_market_order so inner join brt_supplier_receiving sr on sr.order_id = so.order_id inner join brt_market_order_details sod on sod.order_id = so.order_id inner join brt_order_materiel_plan omp on omp.order_details_id = sod.details_id left JOIN brt_materiel m on m.materiel_id = omp.materiel_id left join brt_supplier c on so.supplier_id = c.supplier_id where so.order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT ifnull(mo.delivery_address,'') address, -- 供应商收货地址 ifnull(s.remark,'') remark FROM brt_market_order mo LEFT JOIN brt_supplier s ON mo.supplier_id = s.supplier_id where mo.order_id = #{orderId}
update brt_order_materiel_plan set materiel_num = materiel_num+#{receivingRemindVo.thisNum} where plan_id = #{receivingRemindVo.planId}

SELECT ifnull(omp.order_num,0)-ifnull(omp.materiel_num,0) surplusNum -- 剩余数量 FROM brt_market_order so inner join brt_supplier_receiving sr on sr.order_id = so.order_id inner join brt_market_order_details sod on sod.order_id = so.order_id inner join brt_order_materiel_plan omp on omp.order_details_id = sod.details_id where so.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT so.order_no orderNo, so.receiving_time deliveryTime, -- 计划送货日期 c.supplier_name supplierName, -- 客户名称 so.order_remark remark, -- 备注 so.delivery_address address, -- 送货地址 so.order_time orderTime FROM brt_market_order so inner join brt_supplier_receiving cd on cd.order_id = so.order_id left join brt_supplier c on so.supplier_id = c.supplier_id where so.order_id = #{orderId} limit 0,1

SELECT ifnull(m.materiel_name,omp.materiel_id) materielName, -- 产品名称 m.materiel_unit unit, -- 单位 ifnull(omp.order_num,0) detailsNum, -- 销售数量 sod.details_remark remark, -- 备注 sod.details_price price, -- 单价 sod.details_amount amount -- 总价 FROM brt_market_order so inner join brt_supplier_receiving sr on sr.order_id = so.order_id inner join brt_market_order_details sod on sod.order_id = so.order_id inner join brt_order_materiel_plan omp on omp.order_details_id = sod.details_id left JOIN brt_materiel m on m.materiel_id = omp.materiel_id left join brt_supplier c on so.supplier_id = c.supplier_id where so.order_id = #{orderId}
